{{Quote|You know where he is, don't you?''"<br />"''He told me. He wants you to come. But you're a nice man, Luke Skywalker. I can't send you there. My son wants to kill you.|The woman and Luke Skywalker, discussing her son Brakiss|<ref name="The New Rebellion" />}}
'''Brakiss's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Msst]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The woman became the mother to a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] called [[Brakiss]], but as a baby, he was taken away from her by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the Empire to be trained as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Brakiss was permitted to visit his mother on occasion, but she found him to have changed as a result of his Imperial training and he was resentful of her, believing her responsible for letting the Imperials take him away. When the Empire abandoned Msst shortly after the [[Battle of Bakura]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the woman remained behind and stole various pieces of Imperial equipment that helped her to survive.

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Brakiss visited his mother on Msst and informed her that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] whom Brakiss has briefly [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] under abandoned to return to the service of the Empire, would come to Msst looking for her son. Skywalker was investigating a [[Bombing of the Senate Hall|terrorist bombing]] that Brakiss had organized and Brakiss instructed his mother to direct Skywalker to meet him on the planet [[Telti]]. On arrival on Msst, Skywalker was attacked and injured by the [[mistmaker]]s, a bubble-like predator native to the world. Brakiss's mother rescued the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and placed him into a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] to heal. When Skywalker recovered, she delivered Brakiss's message but tried to dissuade Skywalker from venturing to Telti as she wanted her son to be left alone. Skywalker subsequently departed Mssst and [[Duel on Telti|confronted]] Brakiss on Telti.

==Biography==
===A lost son===
{{Quote|He wasn't a bad boy once, Luke Skywalker. Really he wasn't. He was this bright, wonderful baby. He fairly glowed with life. Then they came.''"<br />"''The Empire.''"<br />"''They came into my home, looked at my boy, and they could use him. Him. A baby. And they took him from me.|The woman and Luke Skywalker, discussing her son Brakiss|<ref name="The New Rebellion" />}}
[[File:BrakissChild.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Brakiss as a child]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] between [[63 BBY]] to [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]]<ref name="Birth" /> and lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Msst]], a small, sparsely inhabited world<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> located in the [[Msst sector/Legends|Msst sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During her [[Time/Legends|time]] on Msst, the woman witnessed many people be attacked by the [[mistmaker]]s, a dangerous [[Species/Legends|species]] of bubble-like predator native to the world, with very few of those attacked surviving. Msst became a stronghold of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the woman became the mother to a [[Youngling/Legends|baby]] boy named [[Brakiss]]<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> and at some point between [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="Brakiss birth">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that Brakiss was born after the [[Declaration of a New Order|foundation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but that he was "still a teenager" during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since the Battle of Endor is dated to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by The New Essential Chronology, if it is assumed that he must have been aged between 13 and 19 years of age at that time he must have been born between [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]].</ref> the woman became the mother . The woman found Brakiss to be a cheerful, happy baby who brought her much joy. However, her [[Time/Legends|time]] with him was cut short; the Empire discovered Brakiss to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and despite his mother's protests, her baby boy was taken away by the Imperials.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

The Empire trained Brakiss in the use of his [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] to serve as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and threatened to harm his family if he did not cooperate.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> The Empire allowed Brakiss to come back to Msst occasionally to visit his mother. Though he feigned happiness when he met her, his mother could tell that he had changed and believed that the Empire had stripped away the goodness in him. In truth, Brakiss blamed his mother for allowing him to be taken away by the Imperials.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

The Empire abandoned Msst shortly after the [[Battle of Bakura]]<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Brakiss's mother remained on the world, living alone in her dwelling, and she stole many pieces of abandoned Imperial medical equipment to furnish her home.<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Brakiss enrolled as a student at the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi academy]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> who sought to establish a [[new Jedi Order]].<ref name="I, Jedi" /> Brakiss eventually fled the [[Jedi academy|academy]] to return to the Empire and he told them everything that he had learned while studying with Skywalker. Brakiss briefly visited his mother on Msst and told her about his betrayal of Skywalker. The woman could tell that her son's sense of guilt arising from his betrayal of his former master concerned Brakiss deeply.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

===Encounter with Luke Skywalker===
{{Quote|I came here&mdash;''"<br />"''Oh, I know And it wasn't the brightest thing you've done, now is it? When you get your feeling back, you crawl into your X-wing and fly away home. Back to your family. You'll be better off.|Luke Skywalker and Brakiss's mother |<ref name="The New Rebellion" />}}
[[File:Brakiss_JATM.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Brakiss]]
Afterward, Brakiss's mother did not hear from her son for a number of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Brakiss eventually became an apprentice to the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]] and aided his new master in hatching a [[Almanian Uprising|plot]] to overthrow the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the government that had replaced the Empire as the dominant regime in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> Circa [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], about six years<ref name="NEC" /> after Brakiss had fled Skywalker's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] academy, he returned to Msst to see his mother and told her that she would shortly receive a visit from Luke Skywalker. He gave her directions to [[Telti/Legends|Telti]], a world on which Brakiss was overseeing the production of [[Bomb/Legends|bomb-laden]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for Kueller, and instructed her to tell Skywalker that Brakiss was waiting for the Jedi Master there.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

After Brakiss and Kueller engineered the [[Bombing of the Senate Hall|bombing]] of the New Republic [[Senate Building/Legends|senate hall]], the meeting place of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]], Skywalker sensed Brakiss's involvement and, having traced Brakiss's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to Msst, ventured there in search of him. Skywalker landed at an abandoned Imperial facility near where Brakiss's mother resided and after disembarking from his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was attacked by a group of mistmakers. On hearing Skywalker's vessel land, Brakiss's mother donned some protective gear and headed out to the [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] in hope that it was Brakiss, but turned away when she saw the mistmakers floating around it. Skywalker slashed one of the mistmakers and it exploded and showered him with [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] [[Color/Legends|pink]] slime, which incapacited him and ate away at his [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] and skin. Brakiss's mother dragged the Jedi Master to safety in her quarters and removed his remaining clothes, then placed him in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] to heal him.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

Following some time in the tank, the woman transferred a still unconscious Skywalker to some [[air cushion]]s, specialist devices designed for treating burn wounds. About a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after his arrival on Msst, the Jedi Master regained consciousness and Brakiss's mother relayed her son's message and provided Skywalker with directions to Telti. However, she warned the Jedi against venturing there as she believed her son was dangerous. Skywalker did not heed her warning and he subsequently left Msst and [[Duel on Telti|confronted]] Brakiss on Telti.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He wants you to find him, Luke Skywalker. I think you should go home. Forget him. Nothing good can come of this. Whatever was good in my boy died a long, long time ago.|The woman, to Luke Skywalker, on her son Brakiss|<ref name="The New Rebellion" />}}
Brakiss’s mother had [[Silver/Legends|silver]]-colored [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and bright blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She was beautiful in her younger years and though she was wrinkled by the time of her encounter with Luke Skywalker, her beauty still shone through. She also wore a silver ring on her right [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

The woman had a tendency to self-edit, often starting a sentence then leaving it unfinished and changing the topic. She loved her son but found Brakiss changed by his time with the Empire and believed that all of his happiness and goodness had been stripped from him. After the Empire abandoned Msst she remained on the world despite being left alone as, though it was inhospitable, Msst was her home. She on occasion missed the presence of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], although by the time of her encounter with Luke Skywalker she had gotten used to living without them and could no longer tolerate their presence.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

When she rescued Skywalker from the mistmakers on Msst and removed the Jedi's clothes while placing him in a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] tank, Brakiss's mother was unmoved by the sight of his naked body as nudity did not phase her. She did not want Skywalker to pursue her son as she believed that all that any goodness in Brakiss had long expired and her son was beyond the Jedi's help. Nevertheless, she considered that Brakiss had gained some productive work outside of the Empire from his position on Telti and she worried that Skywalker's intervention could ruin her son's chances of a future.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brakiss's mother was created by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]] and appeared as character in the [[1996]] [[Bantam Spectra]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]''<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> and it's [[The New Rebellion (abridged audiobook)|associated audiobook]].<ref name="TNR Audiobook">[[The New Rebellion (abridged audiobook)|''The New Rebellion'' abridged audiobook]]</ref> The woman subsequently received minor mentions in several ''Star Wars'' Legends reference books.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="AGTTSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
